verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no vendor documentation of published accuracy benchmarks, evaluation methodology, or a reproducible eval harness for LlamaParse's parsing quality. The only relevant evidence is a single community comment describing a user's own attempt at reproducing an unspecified 'team-reported' faithfulness score, which is insufficient on its own (single tier, no corroborating vendor claim in this pack) to establish either a vendor claim or a documented dispute. missing for 10: vendor-published benchmark suite, accuracy/faithfulness metrics, benchmark dataset, reproducible eval methodology, independent replication studies confirming or denying vendor numbers.
